_help: Bills Overview settings for this folder, edited in the settings window that opens when you double-click the app. Created from the app's built-in defaults; any bill found that isn't listed yet is added as "monthly".
"folder": where the bill files are, relative to this file. "./" = this folder. Also accepts "./samples", "../2026", an absolute path, or "~/...". The PDF (bills-overview.output.pdf) is written there.
"bills": which months each bill is expected. Bills not listed (or null) are shown but never flagged.
A key also covers every bill that starts with it: "Meter 01" covers "Meter 01 Photo 1 Before" etc. The longest matching key wins.
